title: List of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition

entities.name: List of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition
entities.description: An information element that contains a list of PLMNs designated for use during disaster conditions. It is assigned by an allowed PLMN to the UE and associated with the serving PLMN.

entities.name: Allowed PLMN
entities.description: A PLMN that is permitted to assign the list of PLMNs for disaster conditions to the UE.

entities.name: Serving PLMN
entities.description: The PLMN currently serving the UE, with which the disaster PLMN list is associated.

relations.description: An allowed PLMN assigns the list of PLMNs for disaster conditions to the UE.
The list of PLMNs for disaster conditions is associated with the serving PLMN.
